name: loop-kit-dev
description: [DEV] Flow, deep-interview, and turn-gate loop plugin for message interview, flow design, main-flow lifecycle, and active turn continuity.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Deep interview, flow design, and turn-gated continuity for multi-flow agent work.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides deep-interview for intent and scope locking, flow for message interview, flow design, main-flow lifecycle, and handoff conditions, plus turn-gate for phase prefixes, verification, next turn-flow/message routing, and active turn continuity.
defaultPrompt: Use flow for every user message as deep-interview -> flow design -> main flow -> handoff condition, then use turn-gate to keep the turn open until I explicitly stop.
Use deep-interview to lock my intent, scope, tradeoffs, and approval boundary before flow design.
Use phase prefixes for visible phase-start or meaningful progress messages, and after reporting open next turn-flow/message routing unless I explicitly stop.
If a later user message arrives after an explicit or accidental stop, reactivate turn-gate and start fresh intake.
